name: After § 13
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 13a. Underlines that demographic challenges, including low birth rates and an ageing population, pose a long-term risk to the Union’s competitiveness, social models and economic resilience; calls on the Commission to support, within the existing programmes and in full respect of the principle of subsidiarity, Member State policies aimed at helping families, reconciling family and professional life and encouraging young people to start a family;
